items.stem: For a contract to be legally binding, which of the following is an essential element?

options.text: Offer, acceptance, consideration and intention to create legal relations
options.rationale: Correct: these are the essential elements of a valid simple contract.

options.text: Writing signed by both parties in every case
options.rationale: Most contracts need not be in writing.
Court approval is not required to form a contract.
A deposit is not a general requirement for contract formation.

items.explanation: Correct: these are the essential elements of a valid simple contract.

items.stem: Which document sets out the internal rules governing the relationship between a company and its members?

options.rationale: Correct: the articles of association regulate the company's internal affairs.
This records share capital, not internal governance rules.
This lists charges over company assets.
This confirms registered information at a point in time.

items.explanation: Correct: the articles of association regulate the company's internal affairs.

items.stem: Select TWO consequences that generally follow from a company having separate legal personality.

options.text: The company can own property in its own name
options.rationale: Correct: a company can hold property distinct from its members.

options.text: The company can sue and be sued in its own name
options.rationale: Correct: a company has its own legal standing to litigate.

options.text: Members are automatically liable for all company debts
options.rationale: Separate personality means members are not automatically liable.

options.text: The company ceases to exist if a member dies
Directors own the company's assets personally
options.rationale: Company assets belong to the company, not directors personally.

items.explanation: Correct: a company can hold property distinct from its members.
